subject: Console sparkline + per-route summary tile request for partner demo
messages:
From: Jenny Cole <jenny.cole@acme-logistics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: tiny per-route sparkline + cost summary for next week's demo

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the quick sync today. For our product review with the execs next Tuesday we want a single console tile that shows: a 7-day sparkline of token-cost and p50 latency for a named route (the one powering our quote generator), a small numeric summary (7d cost, 7d avg p50, % change vs prior week), and a red/orange anomaly marker if cost or latency spiked >25% day-over-day.

We know this is a slimmed-down view — the goal is to surface "is it healthy?" in one glance and then let the CS team click into a route page. Can you confirm whether we can produce that from the existing route telemetry for ent-route-quote-prod? If not, what minimal instrumentation/query changes do you need? Attaching a sample CSV of their usage and a mockup.

Appreciate any quick feasibility notes — demo is Tuesday 11am PT.

Thanks,
Jenny
Jenny Cole
Director, Platform + Integrations
Acme Logistics
Attachment: acme_usage_sample.csv (csv)
Attachment: mockup-sparkline.png (png)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jenny Cole <jenny.cole@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: tiny per-route sparkline + cost summary for next week's demo

Hi Jenny — thanks, the mock is helpful. Short answer: likely yes for a demoable tile with some caveats.

What we can deliver by Tue: a driven tile that pulls the last 7 days from existing route telemetry (per-request token counters + latency percentiles) and computes a sparkline + two-line summary. Anomaly marker logic (simple day-over-day threshold) we can add client-side in the UI easily.

Caveats / questions:
- We need a reliable route identifier: is ent-route-quote-prod the stable route name across their environment?
- If they expect model-level breakdown (e.g., gpt-ish vs embedder) we may need to enrich the route_id with model hint tags — doable but adds work.
- For the cost numbers: do you want "token cost estimate using hosted pricing" or just raw token counts?

I'll loop in Grace (console UX) and Kim (telemetry/ingest) to scope the minimal backend query and UI. If we can get a sample route_id and a small retention window of 14 days for metric rollups, we can wire a demo tile that points to the full route page on click.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Product Manager, Console
Redwood Inference

Grace / Kim — forwarding Jenny's ask from Acme. Demo constraints: lightweight tile, 7d sparkline for token-cost and p50 latency, small numeric summary and a simple anomaly flag.

Kim: can you confirm whether the route telemetry currently stores daily rollups per route + model? If we only have raw request events we need a short rollup job (cheap) or expensive query at demo time. Best-case: metric table with fields (route_id, date, tokens, p50_ms, model_hint).

Grace: for the tile, we'd prefer a compact layout: left = sparkline (cost), right small stacked numbers (7d cost / 7d p50 / % delta). Click opens route insights. Can you mock a small variant that fits a 320x160 card? If you need sample data, use the attached CSV.

Ben: can you advise on backend query surface and an estimate (hours) to wire one route-specific endpoint that returns {series: 7 points, summary: numbers, anomaly: bool}? This is an internal demo so accuracy can skew conservative.

Goal: get a demoable prototype by Mon EOD so we can iterate with Acme.

Thanks — Adi

Quick feasibility note from infra/telemetry: we already ingest per-request tokens and latencies with route_id and model_hint; however, high-cardinality routes sometimes get sampled. For a single named production route (ent-route-quote-prod) we should have full coverage. Workplan estimate:
- Telemetry query + lightweight aggregation endpoint: 6-8 engineer-hours (1 engineer, build + runbook + smoke tests)
- Small UI tile (mock -> wired to endpoint): 4-6 designer/dev hours (Grace + 1 front-end engineer)
- Anomaly flagging rule: add a simple diff check in the endpoint response or mark client-side (15-30m).

I'll spin up a short rolling aggregation that writes a 7-day window for the demo under a temporary key and share the endpoint by Mon noon. We should use token-cost = tokens * hosted_cost_rate (I'll default to their published tier unless Acme asks otherwise).

Action items (summary):
- Kim: confirm sampling for ent-route-quote-prod and create endpoint (ETA Mon noon).
- Grace: produce compact tile mock and ready-to-wire assets (ETA Mon EOD).
- Aditya: share HubSpot link / final route identifier and confirm cost-vs-token preference with Jenny.

Ben
